name: hdie_pc_ctrl_cfg-cfg-wact-COMMIT
purpose: Physical-slot bank/BG onehots and registered age relations remove queue rotation, dynamic bank-state lookup and decode after priority on the measured -208.2ps write ACT path; same-cycle policy proved against PHYS_WACT0 over54018edges/3850pushes/3818pops/120wraps/1129simultaneous, reversed age mutant rejected. Added state up to2208FF, no normal edges; actual mapped area/clock/route remain to measure. HBM v15 die: ONE configured physical per-PC controller master for all 128 PCs (Codex 2116 configured-PC identity: pc_id/refresh_reload straps, die constants captured in flops at reset); real ot_hbm_r14_stream_pc_strap sequencer + same-row FIFO32 + 32 reserved responses in a real 128x256 SRAM + (WPAY=1, H-DIE 22:50) the 256-bit write payload in a second 128x256 SRAM: 8,192 queue flops and the 32:1x256 head mux removed, clock root 15,219 -> ~7k sinks (hdie_pc_ctrl gate FAIL: CTS rc=137 + 15,219-sink root). Service rate unchanged (issued steady 69,583.3 ps/epoch, capacity PASS, cfg PC/PHASE mutants rejected; write path WR640 exact, stale_head mutant rejected). K side N face (SM service group), PHY row/column/data S face, straps E. Flow control k_rdy/kr_rdy = HBM-stack boundary (owner 10-14). Signs off at die 833.333 ps (runs at 1024 ps).
